lines: Your father threatens to stone you. Your answer?
Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see?
His father said: If you do not stop, I will surely stone you.
He answered: Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord.
Speak gently to your parents today.
The full movie of Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, comes tonight. Follow.

beats.ur: باپ جو سنگسار کرنے کی دھمکی دے… آپ کیا جواب دیں گے؟

beats.en: O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all
If you do not desist, I will surely stone you
Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord

beats.ur: آج اپنے والدین سے نرمی سے بات کریں… چاہے مشکل ہو

beats.text: The full movie of *Prophet Ibrahim (AS)*: tonight, 6:30 PM. Follow.
beats.ur: حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم: آج رات ساڑھے چھ بجے۔ فالو کریں
